subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Shoulder Surfing and Eavesdropping
description: A fast breakdown of Shoulder Surfing and Eavesdropping for builders.

hook.text: The person behind you at the ATM might be memorizing your PIN — not checking their phone.

buildup.text: Shoulder surfing means watching someone enter passwords, PINs, or personal info in public.

discovery.text: High-resolution phone cameras can capture screens from surprising distances.

twist.text: Coffee shop conversations about accounts or Social Security numbers are gold mines for thieves.

climax.text: Low-tech theft like this is nearly impossible to trace because there's no digital evidence.

punchline.text: The thief doesn't need a computer — just good eyesight.

quiz.question: What is shoulder surfing?
options: Watching someone enter private info in public
